purpose: Implement genuinely feedback-conditional bounded counterexample-guided grammar expansion: F127 learned a 3-role linear path program, frozen F128 challenge exposes that this path is insufficient for a conjunctive additional two-edge witness sharing internal path node and terminal. Expand operator grammar ONLY after observed training failure and infer eligible branch roles from actual training graph path signatures; enumerate node-variable join placements and select actual executable AST from train feedback. Preserve that a developer preauthored the possible refinement operator; no claim of open-ended research invention.

cohorts.source: Two independent source-only in-repository challenge constructors A (explicit edge list and role-marginal terminal swaps) and B (schema-keyed adjacency construction, graph reordering, distractor cycles, nonmatching branch alternatives). They are separately authored but NOT independently sourced scientific cohorts.
cohorts.challenge: Require linear 3-hop path start->mid1->mid2->target AND a separate 2-hop branch mid1->other->target. Negative graphs retain the main path and individual auxiliary 2-hop branches but never correct mid1-to-target auxiliary composition, using reciprocal endpoint swap with unrelated start. Distractors include full wrong-start/right-target and right-start/wrong-target branches.

expansion.start: F127 preregistered full 3-hop linear relational-query AST, authenticated from original F127 report. Run it against 16 F128 TRAIN counterexample pairs; it must produce 0/16 paired correct.
expansion.operator: Two-hop existential branch atom sharing root and terminal identity with indexed nodes along linear 3-hop path. Enumerate newly observed unused role-label pairs that form a two-hop witness in train positives. Candidate AST encodes two observed role labels and two source-variable indices from 0 to 3, anchored to actual bound linear-path nodes. This is compiled and executed in a sandboxed finite interpreter only, no Python source generation or arbitrary code execution.
expansion.selection: Evaluate expanded candidates on TRAIN only, maximize paired accuracy, then minimize structural complexity, then stable hashed program ID. The current confirmation cohort and numeric results are never used for source or mechanism design.

controls.simple_f127_path: Must fail paired training and heldout because branch is not checked
controls.global_auxiliary_pairwise_existence: Must fail paired to distinguish independent witnesses
controls.exact_conjunctive_graph_oracle: Upper bound 80/80; never given as a model feature
controls.acceptance_development_only: TRAIN winner reaches 16/16 and new A & B heldout together 80/80; if not preserve negative and do not change the freeze.

continuity.if_schedule: Only authenticated real previous successful scheduled-main F127 artifact may be used; no PR fixture fallback
